Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi there! I need to set up exchanges for a couple of items from my recent order. I received order #W2378156, but both items aren't quite right for me. 

First, I got a mechanical keyboard that I’d like to exchange for the same model but with clicky switches instead of whatever switches it came with. It has an RGB backlight and is full size—I want to keep those if possible, but if you don’t have a version that’s both clicky and has RGB and is full size, then I’d be fine with one that has no backlight at all.

Second, I ordered a smart thermostat, but I need to exchange it for one that’s compatible with Google Home. The one I got is set up for Apple HomeKit instead, which I don’t use.

I want to make sure we get both of these sorted out in one go, so please let me know what details you need from me. I have the order number handy, and I’m in zip code 19122. I don’t remember which email I used, though.

I can help with both exchanges. To get started, I need to verify your account. Since you don't remember which email you used, could you please provide your first and last name? I already have your zip code as 19122.

Sure, my name is Yusuf Rossi. And I have the order number #W2378156 if that helps.

Just to make sure we don’t miss anything—once you’re able to pull up my order, I’d like to confirm the exchange for the keyboard and the thermostat at the same time. I’m also okay if you need the order details or shipping address from me, but I don’t have my email address handy.

2) **Smart Thermostat** — currently black, Apple HomeKit ($262.47). I've selected the **black, Google Assistant** version ($249.01).

Combined, you'd receive a refund of **$16.63**. Your only payment method on file is the credit card ending in **2478**. Would you like the refund to go to that card? Please confirm both exchanges and the refund method, and I'll proceed with them together.

- For the thermostat, you mentioned it’s the Google Assistant version—will that work with Google Home? I specifically need it to work with Google Home, not just the assistant app.
- What’s the exchange process? Will you send the replacement items first, or do I need to return the originals first? Do you provide prepaid return labels? And are there any restocking or shipping fees?

I just want to make sure all of that is covered in one go.

Thanks, Yusuf. Let me address each of your questions:

1. **Keyboard** — Correct. There is no available clicky version that also has RGB and full size, so per your preference we're going with the full-size, clicky switch version without backlight.

2. **Thermostat** — I want to be transparent here. Our catalog only lists compatibility options as "Apple HomeKit," "Amazon Alexa," and "Google Assistant." There is no variant labeled "Google Home" in our system. The available Google-compatible option is labeled "Google Assistant," and I cannot confirm from the information I have whether that specifically works with Google Home. I don't want to make a claim I can't verify.

3. **Exchange process** — Once you confirm, your order status changes to "exchange requested" and you'll receive an email with instructions on how to return the items. I don't have information available about whether replacements ship first, whether prepaid return labels are provided, or whether there are any restocking or shipping fees, so I can't speak to those details.

- Exchange the keyboard (RGB, full size, linear) for the no-backlight, full size, clicky version
- Exchange the thermostat (black, Apple HomeKit) for the black, Google Assistant version
- Combined refund of **$16.63** to the credit card ending in **2478**

Given the uncertainty about Google Home compatibility, would you still like me to proceed with both exchanges as described?
